test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which new initiative was launched by the government on National Sports Day 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Retired Sportsperson Empowerment Training (RESET) Programme**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Retired Sportsperson Empowerment Training (RESET) Programme** was launched by the government on **National Sports Day 2024**.
 
• This initiative is aimed at providing **career opportunities, skill development, and financial stability** to retired sportspersons.
 
• RESET focuses on helping athletes transition from their sports careers to **alternative professional fields**.
 
• The programme includes training in areas such as **coaching, sports management, fitness training, and entrepreneurship**.
 
• It also provides access to certifications, workshops, and mentorship programs to **enhance employability**.
 
• The RESET Programme is part of the government’s efforts to **recognize the contribution of athletes** and ensure their well-being beyond their playing years.
 
• This initiative aligns with the larger vision of promoting **sports culture and holistic support for athletes** in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Sports Scholarship Scheme**__

 __
 
• This option refers to a **hypothetical initiative** involving scholarships for athletes.
 
• While scholarships are an important part of supporting young athletes, there is no specific announcement of a **National Sports Scholarship Scheme** in 2024.
 
 
 
• **Fit India Movement**__
 __
 
• The **Fit India Movement** was launched by the Government of India in **August 2019** to encourage citizens to adopt a **healthy and active lifestyle**.
 
• It focuses on **fitness awareness** and promoting physical activities but is unrelated to the **RESET Programme**.
 
 
 
• **National Fitness Challenge**__
 
 
• This option suggests an initiative promoting fitness challenges, but no such **specific programme** was launched on National Sports Day 2024.
 
• The term aligns with general fitness campaigns but does not pertain to the **RESET Programme**.
